title: Expand the financing instruments named in 4.6
requirements:
- Mention MDB instruments, regional/shared financing and relevant regional funds as options
- Require conservative estimates and an agreed reinvestment mechanism
- Add contributions and pooled funding for DPG tools as sustainment options
- Explain how DPI-H components connect to NHI and PFM systems
- Add an optional pattern using claims or reimbursement submission to drive conformance
- Show which mechanisms suit capital, recurrent, capacity and emergency costs
